title: Newsletter landing page
content:
Landing page for "The Trail Report", the co-op's monthly newsletter.

Headline: The Trail Report, once a month, never more.
What you get:
- Trail and water conditions from members who were just there
- Early booking for workshops
- Repair tips from the workshop
- The used-gear sale date, a week early

Sign-up form: Email (required) and a Subscribe button.
Fine print: We send one email a month. Unsubscribe from any issue.
Social proof: 6,200 readers. A quote from a reader, Jo: "The only newsletter I read the day it arrives."
